I wrote the word counter in Zig (`src/main.zig`, with `build.zig`), and `build.sh` builds an optimized binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` builds it and passes all 6 example cases, and the 3 unit tests (`zig build test`) pass too.

To check speed, I ran a 50 MB generated word file and 50 MB of random bytes through it. Each took about 0.18 seconds.

The program reads all of standard input into memory and lowercases letters in place. It then counts each word directly from that buffer without copyi
